rows.text: The release dated 24 May 2019 states that Prime Minister Narendra Modi met the President that day and tendered his resignation along with the Council of Ministers.
The same release states that the President has accepted the resignation.
The same release states that the President requested Modi and the Council of Ministers to continue till the new Government assumes office.

The President's appointment, the oath or swearing-in, stated effective dates, confidence motions and votes, resignation announcements, letters and acceptances, requests to continue in office and attestations during a continuation stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
